theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.natural_mat (Ψ : DrinfeldAssociator.Associator) {c : ℂ} (hc : Transcendental ℚ c) {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Obj} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃) :
αmat Ψ hc Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ * T3 f₁ f₂ f₃ = kron (↑f₁) (kron ↑f₂ ↑f₃) * αmat Ψ hc X₁ X₂ X₃

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.reidx_T3 {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Obj} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃) :
reidx (assocLegs Y₁ Y₂ Y₃) * T3 f₁ f₂ f₃ = kron (↑f₁) (kron ↑f₂ ↑f₃) * reidx (assocLegs X₁ X₂ X₃)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.disj_blkYZ (X Y Z : Obj) :
Disjoint (blkY X Y Z) (blkZ X Y Z)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.disj_blkXY (X Y Z : Obj) :
Disjoint (blkX X Y Z) (blkY X Y Z)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.ΦB_eq_sl (Ψ : DrinfeldAssociator.Associator) {c : ℂ} (hc : Transcendental ℚ c) {L : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T U : Finset L} (hST : Disjoint S T) (hTU : Disjoint T U) :
ΦB Ψ hc S T U = Ψ.ΦN (c • tsl S T) (c • tsl T U) ⋯ ⋯

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.commute_scalar {L : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (r : ℂ) (X : EndL L) :
Commute (r • 1) X

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.nonResonant_fromBlocks_tsl (Ψ : DrinfeldAssociator.Associator) {c : ℂ} (hc : Transcendental ℚ c) {L L' : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype L'] [DecidableEq L'] {S T : Finset L} {S' T' : Finset L'} (h : Disjoint S T) (h' : Disjoint S' T') :
FuchsianFormal.NonResonant (Matrix.fromBlocks (c • tsl S T) 0 0 (c • tsl S' T'))

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.nonResonant_tsl (Ψ : DrinfeldAssociator.Associator) {c : ℂ} (hc : Transcendental ℚ c) {L : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) :
FuchsianFormal.NonResonant (c • tsl S T)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.smul_tsl_eq {c : ℂ} {L : Type} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) :
c • tsl S T = (c / 2) • (Int.castRingHom ℂ).mapMatrix (2 • BlockResidues.tBZ 2 S T - ↑(S.card * T.card) • 1)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.transcendental_half {c : ℂ} (hc : Transcendental ℚ c) :
Transcendental ℚ (c / 2)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.T3_blkZ {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Obj} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (ha : a.trace = 0) :
T3 f₁ f₂ f₃ * blk (blkZ X₁ X₂ X₃) a = blk (blkZ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃) a * T3 f₁ f₂ f₃

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.T3_blkY {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Obj} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (ha : a.trace = 0) :
T3 f₁ f₂ f₃ * blk (blkY X₁ X₂ X₃) a = blk (blkY Y₁ Y₂ Y₃) a * T3 f₁ f₂ f₃

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.T3_blkX {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Obj} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) (ha : a.trace = 0) :
T3 f₁ f₂ f₃ * blk (blkX X₁ X₂ X₃) a = blk (blkX Y₁ Y₂ Y₃) a * T3 f₁ f₂ f₃

abbrev QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.T3 {X₁ X₂ X₃ Y₁ Y₂ Y₃ : Obj} (f₁ : X₁ ⟶ Y₁) (f₂ : X₂ ⟶ Y₂) (f₃ : X₃ ⟶ Y₃) :
Matrix ((Y₁.tensor Y₂).tensor Y₃).Idx ((X₁.tensor X₂).tensor X₃).Idx ℂ

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.intertwine_tsl {L : Type u_2} {L' : Type u_3} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] [Fintype L'] [DecidableEq L'] (M : Matrix (L' → Fin 2) (L → Fin 2) ℂ) {S T : Finset L} {S' T' : Finset L'} (hS : ∀ (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ), a.trace = 0 → M * blk S a = blk S' a * M) (hT : ∀ (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ), a.trace = 0 → M * blk T a = blk T' a * M) :
M * tsl S T = tsl S' T' * M

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_blkZ (X Y Z : Obj) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk (blkZ X Y Z) a = kron 1 (Z.ρ a)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_blkY (X Y Z : Obj) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk (blkY X Y Z) a = kron (kron 1 (Y.ρ a)) 1

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_blkX (X Y Z : Obj) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk (blkX X Y Z) a = kron (kron (X.ρ a) 1) 1

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_univ {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk Finset.univ a = diag L a

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_inr {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {L' : Type u_2} [Fintype L'] [DecidableEq L'] (S : Finset L') (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk (Finset.map Function.Embedding.inr S) a = kron 1 (blk S a)

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk_inl {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {L' : Type u_2} [Fintype L'] [DecidableEq L'] (S : Finset L) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
blk (Finset.map Function.Embedding.inl S) a = kron (blk S a) 1

theorem QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tB_eq_tsl {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] {S T : Finset L} (h : Disjoint S T) :
BlockResidues.tB ℂ 2 S T = tsl S T + (1 / 2 * ↑(S.card * T.card)) • 1

def QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.tsl {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (S T : Finset L) :
Matrix (L → Fin 2) (L → Fin 2) ℂ

def QOU.KZ.Drinfeld.blk {L : Type u_1} [Fintype L] [DecidableEq L] (S : Finset L) (a : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℂ) :
Matrix (L → Fin 2) (L → Fin 2) ℂ
